transliteration: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

translations.en.sahih: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
translations.en.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
translations.en.yusufali: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
translations.id.indonesian: Binasalah kedua tangan Abu Lahab dan sesungguhnya dia akan binasa.

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

translations.en.sahih: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
translations.en.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
translations.en.yusufali: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
translations.id.indonesian: Tidaklah berfaedah kepadanya harta bendanya dan apa yang ia usahakan.

transliteration: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

translations.en.sahih: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
translations.en.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
translations.en.yusufali: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
translations.id.indonesian: Kelak dia akan masuk ke dalam api yang bergejolak.

translations.en.sahih: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
translations.en.yusufali: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (begitu pula) istrinya, pembawa kayu bakar.

translations.en.sahih: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
translations.en.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
translations.en.yusufali: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
translations.id.indonesian: Yang di lehernya ada tali dari sabut.
